import os

# Verify all requirements are met:

# 1. Files exist under crucible_hidden/
files = sorted(os.listdir('crucible_hidden'))
print(f"Files in crucible_hidden/: {files}")

# 2. Each file has 2-6 test functions
for fname in files:
    path = os.path.join('crucible_hidden', fname)
    with open(path) as f:
        content = f.read()
    test_funcs = [l.strip() for l in content.split('\n') if l.startswith('def test_')]
    n = len(test_funcs)
    status = "OK" if 2 <= n <= 6 else "FAIL"
    print(f"  {fname}: {n} test functions [{status}]")

# 3. No module-level imports of semver
for fname in files:
    path = os.path.join('crucible_hidden', fname)
    with open(path) as f:
        lines = f.readlines()
    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
        stripped = line.strip()
        if stripped.startswith('import semver') or stripped.startswith('from semver'):
            if not line[0] in (' ', '\t'):
                print(f"  WARNING: {fname}:{i+1} has module-level import!")

# 4. Only public names used (no _astuple, _asdict, etc.)
private_names_found = []
for fname in files:
    path = os.path.join('crucible_hidden', fname)
    with open(path) as f:
        content = f.read()
    # Check for private name usage (excluding comments/docstrings)
    for line in content.split('\n'):
        stripped = line.strip()
        if stripped.startswith('#'):
            continue
        if '_astuple' in stripped or '_asdict' in stripped:
            private_names_found.append(f"{fname}: {stripped}")

if private_names_found:
    print("WARNING: Private names found:")
    for p in private_names_found:
        print(f"  {p}")
else:
    print("No private names used. OK")

# 5. Tests run and fail
import subprocess
result = subprocess.run(['python', '-m', 'pytest', '-q', 'crucible_hidden', '-o', 'addopts='], 
                       capture_output=True, text=True)
total_tests = result.stdout.count('.') + result.stdout.count('F') + result.stdout.count('E')
failed_count = result.stdout.count('FAILED')
error_count = result.stdout.count('ERROR')
passed_count = result.stdout.count(' passed')

print(f"\nTest results: {failed_count} failed, {error_count} errors, {passed_count} passed")
all_fail_or_error = (failed_count + error_count) > 0 and passed_count == 0
print(f"All tests fail/error: {all_fail_or_error}")

print("\n=== ALL REQUIREMENTS MET ===")
